mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 50% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives equity market optimism, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1650.0 and RSAFS > 360000.0 in same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction effect size is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in real economic output, which triggers risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal's Rank IC remains below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 3.0% per annum, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals that inflation is outpacing monetary policy response, increasing expectations of future rate hikes and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 5.5 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 350,000 million dollars, combined with a falling GDP growth rate, indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 350000.0 and GDPC1 growth < 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction effect size is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% combined with stagnant payroll growth signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS growth < 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 100, coupled with a rising unemployment rate, indicates a supply-side shock combined with labor market stress, which increases economic uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 100.0 and UNRATE > 4.8 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
